run_f_gold: run f_gold to count subarrays with equal even and odd elements in an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets and print success count results
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which uses a difference tracking approach with positive and negative hash arrays
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that tracks odd minus even element difference to find balanced subarrays
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a dictionary instead of separate positive and negative hash arrays
